command:
cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, re
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_parquet('/app/merged_users.parquet')
print("columns:", list(df.columns))
print("dtypes:\n", df.dtypes)
print(df.to_string(index=False))

assert list(df.columns) == ['user_id','name','email','created_date','status'], list(df.columns)
assert pd.api.types.is_integer_dtype(df['user_id']), df['user_id'].dtype
assert sorted(df['user_id'].tolist()) == [101,102,103,104]
for v in df['created_date']:
    assert isinstance(v, str) and re.fullmatch(r'\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}', v), v

report = json.load(open('/app/conflicts.json'))
assert report['total_conflicts'] == len(report['conflicts'])
assert isinstance(report['total_conflicts'], int)
seen = set()
for c in report['conflicts']:
    assert isinstance(c['user_id'], int)
    assert c['field'] in ('name','email','created_date','status')
    assert isinstance(c['values'], dict) and c['values']
    assert 'selected' in c
    # selected must equal the highest-priority present value
    for src in ('source_a','source_b','source_c'):
        if src in c['values']:
            assert c['selected'] == c['values'][src], c
            break
    key = (c['user_id'], c['field'])
    assert key not in seen
    seen.add(key)
print("structural checks passed; conflicts:", report['total_conflicts'])
EOF
